sources.title: Associates Program Policies
supports: How a Special Link must be tagged (Participation Requirements 2(b))
That prices may only be shown when Amazon serves the link or Creators API / PA API supplies them (2(b))
That Amazon star ratings and customer reviews may not be displayed without Creators API or PA API (5(t))
That link shortening and Redirecting Links are restricted (5(v), 5(w), and Commission Income Statement 2(e))
That a product list link needs additional original content on the site (2(b))
sources.quote: All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site. For example, you must include your Associates ID or "tag" (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
sources.quote_2: Product prices and availability may vary from time to time. Because prices for and availability of Products that you have listed on your Site may change, your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data is displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
sources.quote_3: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.
sources.quote_4: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
supports: The exact disclosure sentence this site must display
That the Associates relationship must be stated clearly and prominently
That Amazon makes no representation about expected traffic or commission income
sources.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
sources.quote_2: We do not make any representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the amount of traffic or commission income you can expect at any time in connection with the Associates Program
sources.note: Section 5 (Identifying Yourself as an Associate). Section 12 (Additional Provisions) also notes that Amazon may review, monitor, crawl and otherwise investigate your Site to verify compliance.

sources.title: Creators API - Welcome to Creators API
supports: The four available operations: SearchItems, GetItems, GetVariations, GetBrowseNodes
The enrolment prerequisites for API access, including the 10 qualifying sales in 30 days threshold
sources.quote: 2. Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API
sources.quote_2: The Creators API is a REST-based API that provides programmatic access to Amazon's product catalog data, enabling publishers, influencers, and affiliate partners to create innovative and engaging shopping experiences for their audiences.

The canonical Special Link shape returned by the API
The partnerTag parameter carrying the Associates tracking ID

supports: Amazon's own definition of an ASIN
That itemIdType defaults to ASIN
That prices are only available through the offersV2.listings.price resource
sources.quote: ASIN | Amazon Standard Identification Number: 10-Character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.

sources.title: Creators API - PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice
supports: That PA-API 5 is deprecated and returns HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException
That the Creators API is the supported successor
sources.quote: The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API.
sources.quote_2: Applications that continue to call PA-API 5 receive an HTTP 403 Forbidden response with an AccessDeniedException

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
supports: That a material connection must be disclosed where the endorsement appears
That disclosures must be hard to miss and in plain language
That a disclosure hidden in an About page or at the end of a post is likely to be missed
sources.quote: Disclosures are likely to be missed if they appear only on an ABOUT ME or profile page, at the end of posts or videos, or anywhere that requires a person to click MORE.
sources.quote_3: Don't use vague or confusing terms like "sp," "spon," or "collab," or stand-alone terms like "thanks" or "ambassador," and stay away from other abbreviations and shorthand when possible.
sources.note: FTC staff publication, November 2019. Refers to the FTC Endorsement Guides.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google
supports: That rel="sponsored" is the correct value for paid or affiliate placements
That rel values may be combined
sources.quote: Mark links that are advertisements or paid placements (commonly called paid links) with the sponsored value.
sources.quote_2: You may specify multiple rel values as a space- or comma-separated list.
sources.note: Google states the linked pages may still be crawled through other means, so rel="sponsored" is a signal, not a removal from the index.

sources.title: What is GitHub Pages?
supports: That this project site publishes from the repository root at https://karagemop466-tech.github.io/Affil3/
That GitHub Pages logs the visitor IP address for security purposes regardless of consent
sources.quote: GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that takes HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files straight from a repository on GitHub, optionally runs the files through a build process, and publishes a website.
sources.quote_2: When a GitHub Pages site is visited, the visitor's IP address is logged and stored for security purposes, regardless of whether the visitor has signed into GitHub or not.
sources.note: Pages configuration for this repository was read from the GitHub REST API on 2026-11-20: source branch main, path /, build type legacy, status built.

verification_log.result: All five submitted link.amazon URLs returned an HTTP redirect to an amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> page. Every destination title and breadcrumb was read from that page.

verification_log.step: Tested whether each submitted token is itself an ASIN
verification_log.result: Three tokens are 9 characters (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV) and so cannot be the 10-character ASIN defined by Amazon. Two tokens are 10 characters (B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) but their /dp/ pages did not return a retrievable listing, so neither was confirmed as an issued ASIN.
Creators API GetItems reference: ASIN means Amazon Standard Identification Number, a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.
PA-API 5 is deprecated and now returns HTTP 403 AccessDeniedException. The Creators API is the supported path, so the research tooling targets Creators API.

verification_log.step: Checked the price and rating display rules
verification_log.result: Prices and star ratings may not be published statically on this site. Both are rendered as a live lookup that stays blank until the API is configured.
